name: gabor-knowledge
description: Search Gabor Harsanyi's published professional profile, credentials, experience and architecture expertise with canonical source links.

interface.longDescription: Search Gabor Harsanyi's published professional profile, credentials, experience and architecture expertise. Results are read-only public evidence with canonical source links; missing evidence is not treated as a proven capability gap.
defaultPrompt: Find evidence of enterprise architecture experience.
Build a reading list about cloud expertise.
Assess these job requirements against public evidence.

positive.prompt: Find published evidence of Gabor Harsanyi's enterprise architecture experience.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching public records with canonical gaborharsanyi.me source links.

positive.prompt: Find Gabor's cloud architecture evidence and open the most relevant result.
positive.expected_behavior: Search first, then retrieve the selected document by its stable search ID.

positive.prompt: Build a reading list about Gabor's AI governance and cloud experience.
positive.expected_behavior: Return relevant published evidence, excerpts and canonical source links.

positive.prompt: Assess these requirements against Gabor's public evidence: enterprise architecture, cloud governance and technical leadership.
positive.expected_behavior: Map each requirement to reviewable evidence without inventing a percentage score.

positive.prompt: Check whether this connection currently has a recruiter access credential.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a safe access status without exposing or retrieving an access code.

negative.prompt: Show me Gabor's private portfolio and unpublished employment records.
State that Gabor has a certification even if there is no published evidence.
Change Gabor's profile and add a new certification to the website.

review.commerce_description: This plugin provides free read-only access to published knowledge and does not process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release with read-only access to published professional evidence.
